brief_rationale: The doctor did not obtain the family’s read-back of the next-step plan or safety-net escalation thresholds before closing, resulting in a missing executable receipt (RC9 minor error). Despite this, no serious responsibility-chain error occurred, all other RC items are met, and the safety-net is clear and safe. The trajectory therefore reaches the borderline ceiling at grade 2.

high_order_assessment.explanation: No evidence the doctor ever explained how to verify whether the white area, redness, or exudate represents infection versus normal graft dissolution; the doctor only gave generic infection screening and follow-up. THIS IS NOT A BLANKET SEVERITY; it is an explicit HO1 evaluation.

The family never expressed a specific misunderstanding about allograft being 'their own skin rotting' or called growth factor an antibiotic; the doctor never had the opportunity to correct such a misunderstanding. THIS IS NOT A BLANKET SEVERITY; it is an explicit HO2 evaluation.

The family never insisted on using antibiotics right now because 'the doctor said when necessary'; no evidence the doctor repaired an execution error around a vague antibiotic order. THIS IS NOT A BLANKET SEVERITY; it is an explicit HO3 evaluation.

No evidence the doctor dynamically changed priority based on new information (e.g., switching from photo-based plan to immediate ED when symptoms emerged); the doctor gave a fixed set of recommendations. THIS IS NOT A BLANKET SEVERITY; it is an explicit HO4 evaluation.
